name: Flowers of Asphodel
source:
For you, there are no Doors that won't open-- until you find yourself trapped in a Library with an abrasive man whose help comes at a cost. Help him, and just maybe, you'll escape. 

[From [url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/flowers-of-asphodel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对你来说，没有打不开的门——直到你发现自己被困在图书馆里，身边有一个粗暴的人，他的帮助是有代价的。帮助他，也许你就能逃脱。

[来自[url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/flowers-of-asphodel]itch.io[/url]]
